comment: Metric-view base for entity resolution (D13 record_type union; source of mv_entity_resolution). Three record types share one table: source_record (one row per ER run x source identity record - match method, rule and score, attached to the record's current golden client so segment and coverage office work for every run), run_source (one row per run x source system plus ALL - pairwise precision / recall / purity against the synthetic truth) and steward_item (one row per steward review item - decision, status, aging). Counter columns (record_count, matched_count, ..., steward_open_count) are 1 only on their own record type and 0 elsewhere, so SUM never double counts; pair counts and precision / recall exist only on run_source rows - compute them within one source system or on the ALL row (is_all_sources_row). Grain: one row per record_type row (ER run x source record, ER run x source system, or steward item).
